title: Breezy Blue | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perched in the heart of Seagrove Beach, this newly constructed coastal retreat offers sweeping Gulf views and effortless access to the shoreline just 200 feet away via deeded beach access. Designed for both relaxation and entertainment, the spacious home comfortably accommodates up to 18 guests with five beautifully appointed bedrooms, including multiple private primary suites and a large bunk room ideal for group stays. Thoughtfully designed living spaces, a game and media room, and expansive balconies create the perfect balance of comfort and coastal luxury, while sunset views over the Gulf provide an unforgettable backdrop to each evening. The outdoor experience is equally inviting, featuring a private pool, a fenced backyard perfect for lawn games, and a fully equipped outdoor grilling and dining area made for relaxed gatherings under the Florida sun. Exploration is effortless with six adult bikes and a six-seater golf cart included, offering easy access to the nearby beach, Seaside, and the charming communities along scenic 30A. Blending upscale amenities with laid-back coastal living, this Seagrove Beach escape delivers a memorable setting for unforgettable beachside vacations.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
